```xml
<robot name="cabinet_2_door">
  <!-- Dimensions (metres) -->
  <!-- Cabinet: 0.98 W (X), 0.59 D (Y), 1.88 H (Z) -->
  <!-- Origin at floor directly under middle of object -->
  <!-- Front faces -Y, back is +Y -->
  <material name="wood">
    <color rgba="0.55 0.40 0.25 1.0"/>
  </material>

  <material name="wood_dark">
    <color rgba="0.45 0.33 0.20 1.0"/>
  </material>

  <!-- ===================== -->
  <!-- Parameters via constants not supported in URDF.
       Use explicit numeric values below.
       Assumptions:
       - Frame (shell) thickness: 0.02 m
       - Back panel thickness: 0.01 m
       - Door panel thickness: 0.018 m
       - Door gap meeting line: 0.004 m (each door overlaps a bit)
       - Door hinge thickness region not explicitly modelled
       - Door hinges as simplified rectangular blocks included in each door link
       ===================== -->

  <!-- ===================== -->
  <!-- Base frame -->
  <!-- ===================== -->
  <link name="cabinet_base">
    <inertial>
      <!-- Mass assumptions -->
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.94" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="35.0"/>
      <!-- Approximate inertia for a box: Ixx= (1/12)m(d^2+h^2), Iyy=(1/12)m(w^2+h^2), Izz=(1/12)m(w^2+d^2)
           Using:
           width X = 0.98
           depth Y = 0.59
           height Z = 1.88
      -->
      <inertia ixx="12.98" iyy="14.56" izz="8.55" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>

    <!-- Collision: full outer bounding box as cabinet body -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.94" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.98 0.59 1.88"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.94" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.98 0.59 1.88"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Remove interior via additional collisions? Not possible. Keep as single body. -->
  </link>

  <!-- ===================== -->
  <!-- Left door (hinged on left vertical edge, opens outward to -Y) -->
  <!-- ===================== -->
  <link name="door_left">
    <!-- Door geometry -->
    <!-- Left half width: 0.98/2 = 0.49 m -->
    <!-- Meeting line center at X=0. Doors swing outward from cabinet sides.
         Hinged on vertical edge located at X=-0.49/???:
         Outer width half is 0.49. Door thickness along X is in width direction.
         Model each door as a box with width 0.49, centered in its half. -->
    <!-- Door dimensions -->
    <!-- size X (width): 0.49
         size Y (depth): door thickness 0.018
         size Z (height): 1.88 -->
    <!-- Frame is centered at X=0, Y=0, Z=0.944
         Cabinet outer: depth 0.59, so front face at Y=-0.295, back face at Y=+0.295
         Doors are mounted at the side edges in X; but hinge described on vertical edge.
         Interpret "vertical edge" as the left/right side edges in X direction,
         with hinge axis along Z at the side.
         Doors swing open outward in Y direction.
         Hence hinge line at:
           Left door hinge at X=-0.49 (outer left side), Y=+0.295? or inside?
         We will place door plane near the front face, with door thickness along Y.
         Hinge line should be along Z at X=-0.49, Y=0 (middle of depth) would not match outward.
         Better: put doors inside front opening; hinge at the front edge of door plane.
         But since swing open outward (toward -Y for left door), hinge axis runs along Z at
         X=-0.49 and Y=-0.295 + 0.01 (slightly in from front).
         We'll place door box centered at Y=-0.295 + 0.009 (so hinge edge sits at Y=-0.295+0.018/2 = -0.286).
         However, hinge axis at a vertical edge likely at cabinet side, not front edge.
         Given ambiguity, we implement hinge axis at cabinet left vertical side edge with door rotating about Z? No.
         URDF revolute axis must be explicit.
         We'll interpret hinge as axis along Z at X=-0.49, running vertically, door rotates about that Z axis.
         That would swing doors open sideways (in X plane). Not desired.
         Therefore interpret hinge axis along Z at the vertical edge at X=-0.49, but door rotates about Z axis? That swings in X-Y.
         To swing outward in -Y, rotation axis should be vertical (Z) and door plane rotates around Z, changing Y.
         That means door rotates around Z at hinge line; door initially aligned with -Y face.
         We'll set revolute axis as (0,1,0)? No: for swing about vertical edge, axis should be along the vertical edge direction,
         which is Z. So axis should be (0,0,1).
         With axis (0,0,1), rotating will move points in X-Y plane. That can swing outward to -Y if hinge at side (X).
         We'll hinge at outer left edge X=-0.49 and center Y=0 initially; door plane rotates.
         Initialize door such that it "faces" the cabinet opening when closed (door plane nearly in X-Y with outward pointing?).
         We'll set door's face normal toward +Y when closed? Complex.
         Simpler: set door box thickness along Y and place it at front plane for closed position.
         Then rotate about Z axis located at side edge X=-0.49 and at Y=-0.295+0.009 (hinge at front edge).
         Axis Z allows swinging in Y as desired for both doors.
    -->

    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.94" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="6.5"/>
      <!-- Approximate inertia for box w=0.49, d=0.018, h=1.88 -->
      <!-- Ixx=(1/12)m(d^2+h^2)
           Iyy=(1/12)m(w^2+h^2)
           Izz=(1/12)m(w^2+d^2)
      -->
      <inertia ixx="5.18" iyy="9.31" izz="0.07" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 -0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.49 0.018 1.88"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.49 0.018 1.88"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Simplified hinge knuckles as small boxes attached to door (for contact realism) -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.235 0 1.35" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.03 0.008 0.08"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.235 0 1.35" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.03 0.008 0.08"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.235 0 0.55" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.03 0.008 0.08"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.235 0 0.55" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.03 0.008 0.08"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <joint name="joint_door_left" type="revolute">
    <parent link="cabinet_base"/>
    <child link="door_left"/>
    <!-- Hinge line location for left door at outer left vertical edge.
         Place joint origin at Z=0 (floor) + (door bottom at 0 so door box center at 0.94).
         URDF joint origin is in parent frame.
         We place the hinge at:
           X = -0.49
           Y = -0.286 (near the front edge of door plane when closed)
           Z = 0 (floor)
         Door frame will be at its box center; we set joint such that door center maps correctly. -->
    <origin xyz="-0.49 -0.286 0.94" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <!-- Axis along Z (vertical edge) -->
    <axis xyz="0 0 1"/>
    <limit lower="-1.5708" upper="1.5708" effort="50" velocity="1.5"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- ===================== -->
  <!-- Right door (hinged on right vertical edge, opens outward to -Y) -->
  <!-- ===================== -->
  <link name="door_right">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.94" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="6.5"/>
      <inertia ixx="5.18" iyy="9.31" izz="0.07" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyz="0"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.49 0.018 1.88"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.49 0.018 1.88"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Hinge knuckles -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.235 0 1.35" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.03 0.008 0.08"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.235 0 1.35" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.03 0.008 0.08"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.235 0 0.55" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.03 0.008 0.08"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.235 0 0.55" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.03 0.008 0.08"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <joint name="joint_door_right" type="revolute">
    <parent link="cabinet_base"/>
    <child link="door_right"/>
    <origin xyz="0.49 -0.286 0.94" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 0 1"/>
    <limit lower="-1.5708" upper="1.5708" effort="50" velocity="1.5"/>
  </joint>
</robot>
```
